as_told.title: Cattle mutilations around the missile field and confiscated camera
as_told.place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

plain: This story is about cattle found dead and cut up around a field of nuclear missile sites tied to Ellsworth, an Air Force base, in 1977. A former missile base guard named Mario Woods says cattle mutilations were going on in the area, and that a reporter, Linda Moulton Howe, was there looking into them. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells it from another veteran, Michael Johnson, who says cattle kept turning up dead in the weeks before a November night when the men say they were abducted, and adds that a camera was taken from them. People tell it because, if true, it ties strange events near nuclear weapons to the abductions those veterans describe.
